# bls-solidity (vendored)

`src/libraries/BLS.sol`, `ModExp.sol` and `Precompiles.sol` are copied unchanged from
https://github.com/randa-mu/bls-solidity at commit `11af179a8287d978659aae07adb66aa60f64b8a6`
(MIT, see LICENSE). Only the files `DrandBeacon.sol` imports are included, so this repository has a single
git submodule (forge-std) and nothing to fetch for the BLS verification.
